This template is for reporting problems with the official TechTalks bootcamp repository only.

Use this template to report:

- Broken links
- Missing submission folders
- Incorrect instructions
- Submission template issues
- Repository configuration problems

Do not use this template to ask for assignment help. Use the Assignment Help template instead.
